Great — I can help analyze your media files. Please provide the files (or links to them) and tell me what kind of analysis you want. Here are some common options:
- Images - Scene description and object detection - OCR for text in images - Color palette and dominant colors - Metadata extraction (EXIF, if available)
- Videos - Overall summary and key frames - Object/scene detection per segment - Audio transcription (speech-to-text) - Transcripts, language, and any on-screen text - Metadata and duration
- Audio - Transcription and language identification - Topic or sentiment (where applicable) - Audio quality and noise notes
- Documents (if any) - OCR text extraction - Layout and key topics
Helpful details to include: - How many files and their formats (e.g., JPG, PNG, MP4, MP3) - Any privacy or sensitivity considerations - Desired depth of analysis (quick summary vs. detailed report)
If you’re ready, upload the files or share links and confirm the analysis you want. I’ll start and report back with a structured result.
